newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton to pursue possible sale, merger.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton to pursue possible sale, merger.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said Tuesday it will move forward to explore the possible sale or merger of the company.
The board authorized the company's management and financial advisors to take action to seek a potential buyer or merger candidate, it added.

Hugoton, an independent oil and natural gas company, said it will continue its active drilling programs in the Hugoton Field Area of Kansas, Oklahoma and Texas, the Williston Basin, north-central Oklahoma, the Austin Chalk Trend and the Permian Basin.

Earlier this month, Hugoton said it intended to continue working with its financial advisors to evaluate various strategic altrnatives. Those alternatives, it said at the time, included a sale, merger or remaining an independent company.

"Hugoton has received a large number of inquiries and indications of interest over the last few weeks," Floyd Wilson, chairman, said in a statement. "It is appropriate that we respond to this high level of interest by exploring the possibility of a sale or merger."
He added the company will compare the results of this effort with the value to be developed by continuing as an independent firm.
